title: Oxygen System
description: Explore a maze with an Intcode repair droid, find the oxygen system, then simulate oxygen filling.
writeup:
## Approach

The maze is unknown and can only be discovered by moving the Intcode droid one step at a time. DFS with backtracking explores the full map, then BFS solves both parts on the discovered grid.

## Part 1

Explore the entire maze via recursive DFS: try each direction, and if the droid moves (status 1 or 2), recurse from the new position, then send the reverse command to backtrack. This builds a complete `{(x,y): status}` map. Then BFS from `(0,0)` to the oxygen system gives the shortest path.

## Part 2

BFS flood-fill from the oxygen system position. The maximum distance reached equals the number of minutes for oxygen to fill every open space in the maze.
